description: Configuration template for comprehensive BEHRT disease analysis

instructions.model_path: Path to trained BEHRT model (.bin or .pth file)
instructions.vocab_path: Path to vocabulary pickle file (without .pkl extension)
instructions.test_data_path: Path to test data parquet file
instructions.batch_size: Batch size for prediction generation (adjust based on GPU memory)
instructions.device: Device to use ('cuda:0' if GPU available, 'cpu' otherwise)
instructions.max_age: Maximum age in vocabulary (should match preprocessing)
